preconditions.description: Both input sequences must be strings.
Both input sequences must have at least one character.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '' or all(c in seq1 and c in seq2 for c in stdout)
postconditions.description: The output must be a subsequence of both input sequences.

postconditions.expression: len(stdout) == max(len(subseq) for subseq in subsequences if all(c in seq1 and c in seq2 for c in subseq))
postconditions.description: The output must be the longest common subsequence.
